consumer_warning.title: Scam alert: fake Pwani Threads page
consumer_warning.body:
Fake page alert: @pwanlthreads is not Pwani Threads.
Don't send money to 0768 123 456.
Pay only via Pochi la Biashara 0700 111 222 (PWANI THREADS) through @pwanithreads.
Please report the fake page and share this message with friends and family.

platform_takedown.body:
I am reporting an account that is impersonating my business, Pwani Threads.

Impersonating account: @pwanlthreads (https://instagram.com/pwanlthreads)
Our official account(s): @pwanithreads (instagram), @pwanithreads (tiktok)

Evidence recorded by Halisi (first seen 2026-09-26):
- Profile picture: perceptual-hash distance 20/64 from our registered logo (visual similarity 35%).
- Name/handle similarity to our official account: 100%.
- It asks customers to pay 0768 123 456, which is not registered to our business.
- Its name imitates Pwani Threads's official account @pwanithreads.
- Asks for payment to a personal number, not Pwani Threads's official payment channel.
- Uses pressure phrases common in scams: 'pochi la biashara', 'tuma pesa'.

Please remove this account. It uses our identity to take payments from our customers.

safaricom_report.body:
Dear Safaricom fraud team,

I am reporting M-Pesa payment details used by a fake social-media page that impersonates my business, Pwani Threads.

Receiving number(s) on the fake page: 0768 123 456
Fake page: @pwanlthreads on instagram (https://instagram.com/pwanlthreads), first seen 2026-09-26.
Our official payment channel: Pay only via Pochi la Biashara 0700 111 222 (PWANI THREADS) through @pwanithreads.

How customers are misled:
- Its name imitates Pwani Threads's official account @pwanithreads.
- Asks for payment to a personal number, not Pwani Threads's official payment channel.
- Uses pressure phrases common in scams: 'pochi la biashara', 'tuma pesa'.

Please investigate the payment details above. Scam SMS can also be forwarded to <Safaricom scam-SMS forwarding short code: confirm on safaricom.co.ke (commonly cited as 333)>.

kecirt_report.body:

Account reported: @pwanlthreads on instagram (https://instagram.com/pwanlthreads)
First seen: 2026-09-26
Our official account(s): @pwanithreads (instagram), @pwanithreads (tiktok)
Payment details shown on the account: 0768 123 456

Evidence recorded by Halisi:
- Profile picture perceptual-hash distance 20/64 from our registered logo.
- Overall impersonation score 90/100 (confidence 0.9).
- Its name imitates Pwani Threads's official account @pwanithreads.
- Asks for payment to a personal number, not Pwani Threads's official payment channel.
- Uses pressure phrases common in scams: 'pochi la biashara', 'tuma pesa'.

I am available to provide further information.
